# axonops_silence (Data Source)

Reads a silence window configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster.
- `cluster_type` (String) The type of cluster (e.g., cassandra, kafka).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the silence window.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the silence is active.
- `cron_expr` (String) Cron expression for recurring silences.
- `datacenters` (List of String) List of datacenters or nodes the silence applies to.
- `duration` (String) Duration of the silence.
- `is_recurring` (Boolean) Whether the silence is recurring based on the cron expression.
